title: Crestline Credit Card Courtesy Credit Worksheet: Amount Credited on a Late Fee
content:
On the Crestline Credit Card, Northgate's courtesy credit schedule figures the courtesy credit on the most recent late fee posted to a Crestline credit card account.

**Amount.** A courtesy credit returns the late fee in full: nothing is credited outright, the credit basis is the whole fee and the share applied to it is 1.0, so the credit equals the amount of the most recent late fee on the account, rounded half up to the cent.

**How the figure is put together.** The courtesy credit is the part credited outright plus the share of the credit basis, the share never above 1.0 however much is added to it, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The most recent late fee | the latest late fee entry on the account's card ledger, by posting date |
| Its amount | that entry's amount as posted (a fee the product capped at the minimum due is taken at the capped amount) |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Most recent late fee on the ledger | 18.00 USD (a fee capped at an 18.00 USD minimum) |
| Part credited outright | 0.00 |
| Credit basis | the whole fee, 18.00 USD |
| Share | 1.0 |
| Courtesy credit: 0.00 plus 1.0 of 18.00 | 18.00 USD |

An account whose latest late fee entry shows 22.50 USD receives a courtesy credit of 22.50 USD under this calculation.
